subject: Object-view
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1019a; w1021a), PB1551 (w1097d; review round 1 finding R1-1). "An object-view shall not be specified as a receiving operand" (cite.py --check 8.4.3.5.3 -> OK 2)). Every receiving position parses the view of a data reference, of SELF, SUPER or NULL as a nonReceivableIdentifier, and the receiving chokepoint refuses it by this rule (COBOL2871) from the ReceivingOperandForms table, as it does the view of a qualified item written as one chain (`MOVE X TO A OF G AS C`, ReceivingFormBar). That includes the BY REFERENCE argument of CALL and INVOKE (14.9.4.3 SR5, 14.9.23.3 SR20) and the implied BY REFERENCE of a keyword-less view (CALL Format 1, a universal INVOKE) — before review R1-1 those drew COBOL0901 on the word AS. The per-statement refusals of SET Format 5 and INVOKE RETURNING (an object-view receiver rule each) are deleted; both now reach the same row. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
